constraints.visibility_safe_region_rationale: V3 is an empirical conservative refinement. It keeps the cap on the verified side of the golden X coordinate (X <= 0.990 m) and in the Y band spanned by the two already validated randomized successes (approximately 0.154-0.156 m), with a small margin. It preserves fixed Z, orientation, robot, controller, cameras, illumination, PhysX, and checkpoint. The 2 mm minimum pairwise XY separation supplies controlled positional diversity in this deliberately small reachable/viewable region while allowing ten total samples.
